settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: How does the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel work with microcurrent treatments?
settings.text1: The gel acts as a conductive agent, allowing microcurrent energy to penetrate the skin more effectively during treatment. It improves the current's ability to stimulate collagen production, increase skin elasticity, and hydrate the skin deeply.
settings.title2: Can I use the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel without a microcurrent device?
settings.text2: Yes, while the gel is specifically designed for use with microcurrent devices, you can also use it on its own as a hydrating treatment for dry skin. It provides deep moisture and improves skin texture without needing a device.
settings.title3: Is the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel suitable for all skin types?
settings.text3: The gel is formulated for dry skin but can be used on all skin types, especially for those needing extra hydration. It is gentle enough for sensitive skin and helps restore moisture without causing irritation.
settings.title4: How often should I use the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel?
settings.text4: For microcurrent treatments, apply the gel each time you use the device. For daily use, you can apply it once or twice a day as part of your regular skincare routine to keep your skin hydrated and smooth.
settings.title5: What are the key benefits of using the ReNu Conductive Tx Gel?
settings.text5:
• Enhances microcurrent conductivity for more effective treatments.
  • Deeply hydrates and replenishes moisture in dry skin.
  • Improves skin texture and elasticity over time.
  • Supports overall skin health with a nourishing Bio-Active Complex.
